name: Agentic
summary: Node.js LTS (nodejs.org), the coding agents Claude Code, Codex, pi and omp (npm, latest), and herdr (herdr.dev's installer) to keep them running.

steps.title: herdr
steps.script:
# herdr keeps coding agents running in their own terminals while nobody is
# connected (herdr.dev). Its own installer, saved before it runs (a cut download
# runs nothing); it checks the binary against the release's SHA-256. Into
# /usr/local/bin, on every user's PATH. Kept once installed.
if [ ! -x "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin/herdr" ]; then
  tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
  echo "› Downloading herdr"
  if ! curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh -o "$tmp/install.sh"; then
    rm -rf "$tmp"; echo 'the herdr installer could not be downloaded'; exit 1
  fi
  if ! HERDR_INSTALL_DIR="$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin" sh "$tmp/install.sh"; then
    rm -rf "$tmp"; echo 'the herdr install failed'; exit 1
  fi
  rm -rf "$tmp"
fi
